say:10:1221609009:0.text: Easy-peasy! Chippy's mastered it in a heartbeat!

document:11:50:0.text:
Maintenance Steps:
1. Remove dust and foreign matter from the surface of the <style="highlight">rusted iron sword</style>.
2. Apply <style="highlight">cleaning oil</style>, <style="highlight">lubricating oil</style>, and <style="highlight">rust prevention oil</style> in sequence to the surface, wiping repeatedly until the rust disappears.

Note: Use a clean, soft cloth or piece of leather when wiping.
